$comment: QUIZ-011 Karl-PASS allowlist. Suppresses CLASSIC-CYCLING placeholder findings for quizzes whose answer arrays have been verbatim-verified against the Confluence Solutions Manual. Hash drift fires QUIZ-011B (stale-allowlist). See _docs/operations/karl-quiz-011-mode2-batch-2026-05-09.md.

schema.answerHash: Stable sha1 of JSON.stringify(quiz_keys.json[id].answers). Computed via placeholder-detector.getAnswerHash().
schema.verifiedAt: ISO date of Karl Mode-2 PASS verdict
schema.karlAuditPath: Repo-relative path to the Karl audit doc that contains the verdict
schema.confluencePage: Confluence page ID housing the verified answer index
